d: Can the manosphere run the 2026 US midterms? From Donald Trump and Joe Rogan to Jake Paul and Logan Paul, masculinity, influencers, and American politics have become increasingly intertwined. Hem Kaur Saroya examines how Trump won young male voters in 2024, how the manosphere became a political force, why some influencers are now turning critical of Trump 2.0, and what the Paul brothers’ Pentagon visit could signal ahead of the midterms.
